resources.string: Grant notification access to enable announcements
Notifications are announced using your device\'s text-to-speech engine. Ensure your media volume is turned up and TTS is configured in device settings.
Access is granted; waiting for Android to connect the listener.
Notifications are queued while text-to-speech starts.
Check your device text-to-speech settings, then turn notification access off and on to retry.

After the sender announcement, wait for the ready beep, then say read it during the two-second microphone window. Use Test microphone to check recognition without waiting for a message. Voice mode resumes when you reopen the app unless you disabled it. Your system speech provider may process audio online.
Individual chats only; groups and SMS are excluded
